jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Workforce Productivity
jobs.description:
This role focuses on analyzing and monitoring labor performance to ensure operational efficiency and cost control. The position involves tracking labor metrics against budget, identifying trends and variances, and supporting forecasting and reporting efforts. It plays a key part in maintaining accurate data, improving reporting processes, and helping leadership address underperforming or over-budget jobs. The role also collaborates closely with operations, finance, and field leadership teams to drive performance improvements while supporting job setup, account onboarding, and ongoing labor planning.

Overall, it’s a data-driven, entry-to-mid level analytical role that blends finance and operations, offering exposure to cross-functional teams and opportunities to grow in workforce planning, performance management, and business analysis.

**Benefit Information:** ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM 2026 Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

Pay: $80,000-$100,000  
The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s  
education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.  
You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

* Track and report daily and weekly labor performance vs. budget
* Analyze labor data to identify variances, trends, and cost-saving opportunities
* Support forecasting and monitoring of labor hours, productivity, and expenses
* Assist in identifying and escalating over-budget jobs to leadership
* Maintain accuracy of labor and operational data, including square footage, scope of work, and labor hours
* Support job setup and closeout processes, ensuring proper labor coding and cost tracking
* Assist with onboarding new accounts by validating labor assumptions and inputs
* Monitor overtime, temp labor, and scheduling inefficiencies to identify improvement opportunities
* Participate in performance review processes and help track corrective actions
* Maintain reporting tools, dashboards, and data files to support decision-making
* Ensure data integrity by identifying and resolving discrepancies
* Support process improvements to enhance reporting efficiency and visibility
* Assist with branch and account performance analysis, including identifying drivers of underperformance
* Collaborate with operations and finance teams to support performance improvement efforts
* Provide timely and accurate ad hoc analysis as needed
* Report directly to the Sr Director of Workforce Productivity
* Provide analytical and operational support to the Sr Director of Workforce Productivity
* Partner closely with District Managers and Branch Managers to support day-to-day labor performance and execution
* Collaborate with the FP&A to align reporting, forecasting, and financial insights
* Work cross-functionally with operations and finance teams to support business performance

**Key Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related field
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Proficiency in Excel; experience with data tools a plus
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively

**Success Metrics**

* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting
* Quality and usefulness of analysis
* Improvement in data integrity and reporting processes
* Contribution to labor cost optimization efforts

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

**Role Summary**

Fanatics Collect is a marketplace for trading cards and collectibles. A growing share of our supply and demand comes from businesses: hobby shops listing thousands of items, dealers managing thousands of cards on behalf of collectors, and breakers buying in volume.

We're looking for a Senior PM to build the B2B side of the Marketplace: the tools, agentic APIs and partner integrations that make Fanatics Collect the best place for professional sellers and buyers to do business at scale.

* **Pro Seller:** tools for high-volume sellers to list, price, manage and fulfill inventory at scale, with corresponding analytics to help them optimize their business.
* **Pro Buyer:** bulk buying and API access for volume buyers, including automated buying against predefined criteria.
* **Agentic commerce:** make Fanatics Collect the marketplace AI agents are built for, from agent-ready APIs and integrations with AI assistants to on-site agentic buying and selling experiences.
* **Partner integrations:** integrations across the Fanatics ecosystem to offer sellers more distribution channels and help them get their inventory in front of millions of sports fans.
* **Operating at scale:** build automated solutions for onboarding new hobby shops, enforcing quality controls, etc.
* **Strategy and execution:** set success metrics, priorities, and partner with design, engineering, Commerce, Finance, Ops and Sales to ship.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including marketplace or commerce products.
* Experience with platform or API products or partner integrations; comfortable with technical tradeoffs and working closely with engineers.
* Track record of taking a new, ambiguous area from problem definition to shipped product.
* Data fluent: sets metrics, reads the data, makes the call.
* Comfortable in a fast-moving, cross-functional org
* AI-first: builds with AI every day (prototyping, analysis, specs) and looks for where AI can reshape the product, not just speed up the work.

Feel free to ask your recruiter for a phone call or other type of communication for interview, and ensure your communication is coming from a Fanatics email address (including @collectfanatics.com). For added security, where possible, apply through our company website at* *www.fanaticsinc.com/careers*

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. * Develop solutions to complex problems with minimal supervision, requiring the regular use of ingenuity and creativity

* 5+ years financial reporting and analysis experience, preferably in the Life Insurance and Annuity industry

* Adaptable to using/understanding various system functionalities including Microsoft Office products. Excel proficiency is a non-negotiable requirement, though VBA programming is not required

* Demonstrated ability to prioritize/communicate conflicting demands in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work independently on assignments of various levels of complexity

* CPA, CMA, or MBA preferred
* Proficiency in Oracle, Essbase, Alteryx, Tableau, and Workiva is a plus

jobs.title: FP&A Lead
jobs.description:
HealthSnap (healthsnap.io) is hiring an FP&A Lead to join a small, high-performing finance team and make an

immediate impact on how we drive margin and profitability.

**About HealthSnap**

HealthSnap provides a remote care management platform built for providers and health systems to manage chronic conditions. We help care teams identify risk earlier, engage patients between visits, and deliver better outcomes at scale. As we grow, we are focused on gross margin expansion and sustainable profitability, and finance is central to how we get there.

**The Role**

As our FP&A Lead, you will be the analytical engine behind our margin and profitability goals. You will turn operational, clinical, and contract data into clear decisions for the executive team and board, and you will have direct exposure to senior leadership from day one. This is not a reporting-only seat. We need someone who finds where margin is leaking, quantifies the opportunity, and works with operators to fix it.

You will join an existing, small finance team and report to the Corporate Controller. Expect broad scope, high visibility, and real ownership.

**What You'll Do**

**Gross margin analysis**

* Build and maintain a detailed gross margin model covering cost of service: devices, cellular connectivity, clinical operations, and logistics.
* Track unit economics per patient and per program, and identify the levers that move margin (device cost, cellular fees, staffing productivity, utilization).
* Partner with Operations, Clinical, and Supply Chain to turn findings into specific initiatives with owners and measurable targets.

**Budgeting, forecasting, and board reporting**

* Support the annual budget and rolling forecasts with driver-based revenue, COGS, and opex models.
* Prepare monthly management reporting and variance analysis that explains what happened, why, and what we are doing about it.
* Build KPI packages, scenario analyses, and supporting materials for executive and board meetings.

**Customer and contract profitability**

* Build customer- and contract-level P&Ls to show which health system relationships, pricing structures, and contract terms drive or erode margin.
* Model the financial impact of contract negotiations, addenda, fee changes, and renewals before they are signed.
* Flag underperforming accounts and recommend pricing or operational responses.

**Pricing and APCM/agentification unit economics**

* Model pricing scenarios and the economics of new care models, including Advanced Primary Care Management (APCM) and agentification (automation of clinical and operational workflows).
* Quantify the margin impact of automation, including cost-to-serve before and after.
* Support go-to-market and product decisions with clear ROI and payback analysis.

**Finance operations partnership**

* Work closely with the Corporate Controller to keep actuals, close processes, and forecasts tightly aligned.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years of FP&A, corporate finance, or strategic finance experience.
* Strong financial modeling skills (three-statement and driver-based) and advanced spreadsheet skills in Google Sheets or Excel.
* Demonstrated experience with gross margin, unit economics, or customer profitability analysis.
* Ability to communicate findings simply and directly to executives and non-finance partners.
* Comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward action, and the discipline to get the numbers right.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

**Our stack (familiarity preferred):** QuickBooks, Salesforce, Databricks, Tableau, Coefficient, and Google Workspace.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in healthcare, health tech, or RPM, including familiarity with CPT billing codes, Medicare reimbursement, or value-based care economics.
* Experience supporting executive or board reporting.
* Experience in a high-growth or tech-enabled services company with a focus on margin improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 days:** Learn the business and the data. Map the full cost-of-service structure and current margin by customer and program.
* **First 90 days:** Deliver a gross margin bridge and a customer profitability view that leadership uses in decisions. Own the monthly reporting cadence with the Corporate Controller.
* **First 12 months:** Own the budget and forecast process alongside the Controller, and have clear fingerprints on measurable margin improvement and on pricing and contract decisions.

**Compensation and Benefits**

**Base salary range:** $100,000 to $125,000 per year, depending on experience and skills. Fully remote within the US.

Bonus or equity may be considered as part of a total compensation package.

Benefits include health, dental, vision, 401(k), and PTO.

Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. HealthSnap is unable to provide employment-based visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Allia Health Group**
============================

Allia Health Group is a fast-growing digital health system revolutionizing metabolic, hormonal, and longevity care. As the parent organization behind Brello Health (women's telehealth and longevity programs), HelloWellness (men's telehealth), Southend Pharmacy (a state-licensed 503A compounding pharmacy), and Zito Care (our healthcare provider network), we deliver seamless, end-to-end care powered by a shared technology and AI platform.

We remove barriers so clinicians can focus on patients and patients can access personalized, proactive care on their own terms — whether through telehealth visits, compounded medications, lab testing, wellness support, and more, all in one connected experience across 35+ states.

Allia is building the future of healthcare by being clinician-first and patient-centered. We are innovative, empathetic, and accessible to our patients, combining cutting-edge tools with human-centered care to make high-quality longevity and wellness solutions affordable and available to more people.

**Position Overview**

This role supports the day-to-day operation of the company's SOC 2 program, and over time will help build out our ISO 42001 AI Management System (AIMS) and AI governance program.

The immediate priority is keeping SOC 2 controls, evidence, and remediation on track throughout the year, not just ahead of audit season. The analyst will work with IT (including the CTO/CISO and their team), Security, HR, Legal, and other control owners to turn compliance requirements into concrete tasks, keep evidence current, flag gaps early, and keep the organization audit-ready on an ongoing basis.

The role reports to the Chief Compliance Officer, who retains ownership of the compliance program. The analyst operationalizes and maintains technology-related controls alongside IT while providing independent compliance oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

*SOC 2 & continuous compliance*

* Coordinate evidence collection, validation, and remediation across control owners; follow up on overdue or incomplete items.
* Maintain audit readiness year-round rather than treating SOC 2 as an annual exercise.
* Identify control gaps, exceptions, and deficiencies, and coordinate remediation with the responsible team.
* Support SOC 2 Type 2 audit fieldwork and auditor requests.
* Escalate overdue or material issues to the CCO and relevant IT/business leadership.

*Drata administration*

* Operate and maintain Drata day to day, including API integrations and automated evidence sources.
* Investigate and remediate failed automated tests and compliance exceptions.
* Keep evidence complete, accurate, and correctly mapped to controls.
* Look for ways to automate manual evidence collection and cut recurring effort.

*ISO 42001 & AI governance*

* Support building the AIMS: policies, procedures, controls, risk assessments, and supporting documentation.
* Help build and maintain an inventory of AI systems, applications, and use cases.
* Coordinate AI risk and impact assessments, control activities, and evidence collection.
* Work with IT and business stakeholders to put AI governance requirements into practice.
* Support future ISO 42001 readiness assessments and certification work.

*SaaS & vendor governance*

* Maintain the SaaS/technology inventory.
* Support security and compliance reviews for new and existing vendors (SOC reports, questionnaires, certifications, contract requirements).
* Track vendor compliance gaps and remediation, and keep related evidence current for SOC 2 and applicable ISO 42001 requirements.

*Risk management*

* Maintain the risk register and coordinate periodic updates with risk owners.
* Support information security, technology, third-party, and AI-related risk assessments.
* Facilitate quarterly access reviews and track completion and remediation.
* Escalate material or overdue risks to the CCO and appropriate leadership.

*Audit readiness*

* Organize and maintain documentation for SOC 2 and ISO 42001 assessments.
* Coordinate responses to auditor and assessor requests, and maintain audit trails.
* Track findings and corrective actions through closure.

*Reporting*

* Build monthly compliance and IT dashboards for leadership: MFA coverage, access review completion, onboarding/offboarding SLAs, evidence completion, remediation status, vendor reviews, and trends.
* Surface upcoming deadlines, overdue items, and risks that need management attention.

**Qualifications**

* 2–5 years in compliance, GRC, information security, IT audit, or risk management.
* Working knowledge of SOC 2 and information security controls.
* Experience with a GRC/continuous compliance platform (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe, or similar).
* Experience coordinating evidence collection and remediation across technical and business teams.
* Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Able to work independently, spot gaps, and drive issues to resolution.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting ISO 42001 or another AI management system.
* Experience with AI governance, AI risk assessments, or emerging technology risk.
* HIPAA or healthcare compliance experience, ideally in a technology or regulated environment.
* ISO 27001 or other ISO management-system experience.
* CISA, CISM, CRISC, Security+, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001 certification or training.

**What success looks like**

Continuous SOC 2 readiness, evidence and remediation completed on time, clear accountability among control owners, and fewer items requiring manual escalation. Over time, a working foundation for ISO 42001 and AI governance: a documented AI inventory, risks, controls, and ongoing monitoring.

**What We Offer:**

**About Allia Health Group**

Allia Health Group is a fast-growing digital health system revolutionizing metabolic, hormonal, and longevity care. **Position Overview**

This role supports the day-to-day operation of the company's SOC 2 program, and over time will help build out our ISO 42001 AI Management System (AIMS) and AI governance program.

The immediate priority is keeping SOC 2 controls, evidence, and remediation on track throughout the year, not just ahead of audit season. The analyst will work with IT (including the CTO/CISO and their team), Security, HR, Legal, and other control owners to turn compliance requirements into concrete tasks, keep evidence current, flag gaps early, and keep the organization audit-ready on an ongoing basis.

The role reports to the Chief Compliance Officer, who retains ownership of the compliance program. The analyst operationalizes and maintains technology-related controls alongside IT while providing independent compliance oversight.

**Key Responsibilities**

*SOC 2 & continuous compliance*

* Coordinate evidence collection, validation, and remediation across control owners; follow up on overdue or incomplete items.
* Maintain audit readiness year-round rather than treating SOC 2 as an annual exercise.
* Identify control gaps, exceptions, and deficiencies, and coordinate remediation with the responsible team.
* Support SOC 2 Type 2 audit fieldwork and auditor requests.
* Escalate overdue or material issues to the CCO and relevant IT/business leadership.

*Drata administration*

* Operate and maintain Drata day to day, including API integrations and automated evidence sources.
* Investigate and remediate failed automated tests and compliance exceptions.
* Keep evidence complete, accurate, and correctly mapped to controls.
* Look for ways to automate manual evidence collection and cut recurring effort.

*ISO 42001 & AI governance*

* Support building the AIMS: policies, procedures, controls, risk assessments, and supporting documentation.
* Help build and maintain an inventory of AI systems, applications, and use cases.
* Coordinate AI risk and impact assessments, control activities, and evidence collection.
* Work with IT and business stakeholders to put AI governance requirements into practice.
* Support future ISO 42001 readiness assessments and certification work.

*SaaS & vendor governance*

* Maintain the SaaS/technology inventory.
* Support security and compliance reviews for new and existing vendors (SOC reports, questionnaires, certifications, contract requirements).
* Track vendor compliance gaps and remediation, and keep related evidence current for SOC 2 and applicable ISO 42001 requirements.

*Risk management*

* Maintain the risk register and coordinate periodic updates with risk owners.
* Support information security, technology, third-party, and AI-related risk assessments.
* Facilitate quarterly access reviews and track completion and remediation.
* Escalate material or overdue risks to the CCO and appropriate leadership.

*Audit readiness*

* Organize and maintain documentation for SOC 2 and ISO 42001 assessments.
* Coordinate responses to auditor and assessor requests, and maintain audit trails.
* Track findings and corrective actions through closure.

*Reporting*

* Build monthly compliance and IT dashboards for leadership: MFA coverage, access review completion, onboarding/offboarding SLAs, evidence completion, remediation status, vendor reviews, and trends.
* Surface upcoming deadlines, overdue items, and risks that need management attention.

**Qualifications**

* 2–5 years in compliance, GRC, information security, IT audit, or risk management.
* Working knowledge of SOC 2 and information security controls.
* Experience with a GRC/continuous compliance platform (Drata, Vanta, Secureframe, or similar).
* Experience coordinating evidence collection and remediation across technical and business teams.
* Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Controls.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Able to work independently, spot gaps, and drive issues to resolution.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting ISO 42001 or another AI management system.
* Experience with AI governance, AI risk assessments, or emerging technology risk.
* HIPAA or healthcare compliance experience, ideally in a technology or regulated environment.
* ISO 27001 or other ISO management-system experience.
* CISA, CISM, CRISC, Security+, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001 certification or training.

**What success looks like**

Continuous SOC 2 readiness, evidence and remediation completed on time, clear accountability among control owners, and fewer items requiring manual escalation. Over time, a working foundation for ISO 42001 and AI governance: a documented AI inventory, risks, controls, and ongoing monitoring.
